items.title: Chink Martin Interview, 1966-10-19
items.q: I played there with Sharky, and I played with a joke about myself, Leo Eves, and Arthur Schellang.

ctx.x: Because the way they tell me, I don't know, but he used to have a house that all the... sides of his house, the fence was Honeysuckle Inn. And that's where you give it to Honeysuckle. I played there with Sharky, and I played with a joke about myself, Leo Eves, and Arthur Schellang.
Oh, Augie Schellang. The drummer, Augie Schellang. I remember Augie. That's another story.
